scope: Cross-channel follow-up for the 62 saved early chronology leads; this is a bounded backlog, not all missing records.
rules: Search server-wide without an in: channel constraint; follow matching posts to nearby context and original media.
Inspect image-only posts: text queries cannot find times shown only inside images.
Search player and course aliases, video IDs, reposts and related tour dates when a literal time search fails.
Record each completed search with query, date bounds, capture path and result message/channel IDs. Pending entries are not proof of absent evidence.
Verify message channels from permalinks or full channel context, never attachment CDN paths.
